children: GameStop Corp. reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $790.2M and diluted EPS of $0.51, compared with $972.2M and $0.31, respectively, in the prior-year quarter; net income rose to $298.7M from $168.6M.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share”.
Revenue mix shifted toward Collectibles, which accounted for 45.1% of quarterly net sales and helped improve gross margin versus the prior year.
Video Games and Pre‑Owned sales declined, in part due to hardware launch timing, weighing on overall top-line performance.
Retail optimization continued: GameStop closed 727 U.S. stores in FY25 and retains a reduced footprint focused on core logistics and fulfillment.
SG&A reductions from lower rent, labor and marketing expense and exits from international markets supported improved operating results.
Management prioritizes the balance sheet for investments, acquisitions and equity stakes to drive long-term value creation.
